_comment: MANUAL, SNAPSHOT DATA - NJP has no public API. These are PLACEHOLDER structure examples only. Before the hackathon, replace with 2-3 REAL, CURRENTLY OPEN listings copied by hand from njp.gov.pk, and set 'source_date' to the day you captured them. Never present this file's placeholder content as real to a judge.

jobs.name: REPLACE ME: exact job title from njp.gov.pk
jobs.target_group: REPLACE ME: e.g. BS Computer Science graduates
jobs.summary_en: REPLACE ME: one-line summary of the role

eligibility_conditions.application_deadline: REPLACE ME: YYYY-MM-DD, must be a FUTURE date at demo time

required_documents: REPLACE ME: from the actual ad
application_steps: REPLACE ME: from the actual ad
jobs.source_date: REPLACE ME: date you captured this listing
jobs.disclaimer: Manually captured snapshot, not a live feed. Deadline must be double-checked the day before the demo - if it has passed, remove or replace this entry.
